cohort: 200 patients undergoing various abdominal and pelvic surgeries, including lower segment cesarean section, total abdominal hysterectomy, ovarian cancer surgery, myomectomy, ovarian cystectomy, and laparotomy for ectopic pregnancy, at two hospitals in Pakistan.
finding: No adhesions were found in any of the 12 patients who underwent repeat surgery within a year of the initial procedure where hyaluronic acid gel was used.
